meta.description: Handcrafted silver and women's jewelry by M'Arte — Polish atelier, pure forms, and 925 silver.
meta.title: M'Arte | Handcrafted Jewelry

heroSection.description: In a world of mass copies, choose uniqueness. M'Arte is raw minerals and precious metals that will become an intimate extension of your identity.
heroSection.scrollHint: Scroll to discover the world of M'ARTE

craft.title: Hand precision
craft.description: You receive a detail perfected by artisans. Subtle differences in texture are proof that you wear a true unique piece, not a mass cast.

material.title: Precious materials
material.description: 925 silver and selected minerals. We create with metals that beautifully interact with light and give a feeling of luxury on the skin.

service.title: Details that bring joy
service.description: From the moment of choice to opening the box. We ensure a seamless shopping process and elegant packaging that turns shopping into a reward for yourself.

newArrivalsSection.title: New designs to discover
newArrivalsSection.description: Curated, original forms and noble glow. New designs created for your daily rituals and timeless elegance.

categoriesSection.title: Space of choice
categoriesSection.description: Our jewelry takes various shapes, but adheres to one principle: uncompromising quality. Browse the categories and find the form missing in your space.

necklaces.title: Refined simplicity
necklaces.subtitle: Forms gracing the collarbone line and pure proportions. Created to be an intimate accent worn close to the heart.

earrings.title: Precise accents
earrings.subtitle: From minimalist studs to stronger forms. Designed to frame the face and be a distinct point of your image.

chokers.title: Strong lines
chokers.subtitle: Solid weaves and minerals arranged close to the body. A structural detail that catches light and effortlessly defines the entire styling.

bracelets.title: Fluid structures
bracelets.subtitle: Polished metal that softly drapes on the wrist. Created to be worn solo or build strong, layered compositions.

birthdayBracelets.title: Personal talisman
birthdayBracelets.subtitle: Natural stones assigned to birth months. A thoughtful accent captured in our raw aesthetic, staying with you for years.

videoExperienceSection.description: Some stories deserve their own shape. From the first inspiration to manual finishing – we create jewelry that exists in only one copy. Yours.

articles.golden: Care ritual: how to properly care for your daily jewelry
articles.sustainability: The art of proportion: how to build layered compositions
articles.engraving: Mineral guide: meaning and choice of natural stones

manifestoSection.title: We don't follow seasons.
manifestoSection.subtitle: We follow conviction.
manifestoSection.paragraph1: We believe that in a world rewarding speed, the greatest luxury is time dedicated to detail. We reject mass production in favor of forms that truly deserve to exist.
manifestoSection.paragraph2: Silver is our canvas, natural stones are our punctuation. We create for those who know that true elegance is never loud. It speaks through detail and uncompromising quality.
manifestoSection.paragraph3: This is not fast fashion translated into metal. This is jewelry as architecture — a considered, durable form that becomes a solid foundation of your image.
manifestoSection.closing: Welcome to the world of M'ARTE.

philosophySection.title: Designed to endure
philosophySection.paragraph1: We believe in objects that outlast their season. Each M'ARTE form is born from restraint — fewer collections, deeper intention — because permanence is the ultimate luxury.
philosophySection.paragraph2: Our studio works at the rhythm of craft, not commerce. From the first wax carving to the final polish — every gesture is deliberate, every surface considered.

silverPremiumSection.description: Our flagship 925 silver collection. Each piece is carefully crafted by artisans with years of experience. The combination of tradition and modern design creates jewelry that delights on every occasion.

maisonHeritageSection.title: Tradition and precision
maisonHeritageSection.description: We were founded to combine classic jewelry techniques with modern, raw forms. Each of our projects is the result of precise work and an uncompromising approach to minimalism.

newsletterSection.title: Stay close to M'ARTE
newsletterSection.description: Stay up to date with new products and receive private discount codes available only for subscribers.
newsletterSection.note: By subscribing, you agree to the processing of data for marketing purposes, in accordance with the Terms and Privacy Policy.
